profile: feature-touching weights: In linear regression, the parameters w1 through wN are called feature-touching weights, as each touches a corresponding input feature. The bias w0 is the only weight that does not touch a feature. Thus, in the linear model, all non-bias weights are associated with an individual input feature.

draft.profile: feature-touching weights: In linear regression, the parameters w1 through wN are called feature-touching weights, as each directly multiplies a corresponding input feature. The bias w0 is the only weight that does not touch a feature. They are also known as slope weights or coordinate-wise slopes.
